title: bromus sterilis var. maximus
intro: Bromus sterilis var. maximus, commonly known as Tower Wheatgrass or Tall Brome, is a perennial grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions due to its rich content of bioactive compounds. The health benefits of Bromus sterilis var. maximus include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to protect against cell damage, reduce inflammation, and fight against infections. The therapeutic actions of this plant include antispasmodic, anti-diarrheal, and expectorant properties, which can help to relieve muscle spasms, treat gastrointestinal issues, and alleviate respiratory problems, and its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids.
